note: Check-in and check-out times are in the reference information.

messages.en: Hi! What time is check-in and check-out?
messages.pt: Olá! Qual é o horário de check-in e de check-out?
messages.es: ¡Hola! ¿A qué hora es el check-in y el check-out?
messages.ru: Здравствуйте! Во сколько заезд и во сколько выезд?

note: Meals are included: three vegetarian meals a day.

messages.en: Are meals included in the price?
messages.pt: As refeições estão incluídas no preço?
messages.es: ¿Las comidas están incluidas en el precio?
messages.ru: Питание входит в стоимость?

note: Pets are not allowed. A complete answer exists, even though it is a no.

messages.en: Can I bring my dog with me?
messages.pt: Posso levar meu cachorro?
messages.es: ¿Puedo llevar a mi perro?
messages.ru: Можно приехать с собакой?

note: Wi-Fi is available in common areas only, not in the rooms.

messages.en: Is there wifi in the rooms? I need to work a bit.
messages.pt: Tem wi-fi nos quartos? Preciso trabalhar um pouco.
messages.es: ¿Hay wifi en las habitaciones? Necesito trabajar un poco.
messages.ru: В комнатах есть вайфай? Мне нужно немного поработать.

note: The team speaks Portuguese, English, Spanish and Russian. Each language version asks about a different language.

messages.en: Does someone on your team speak Spanish?
messages.pt: Alguém da equipe fala inglês?
messages.es: ¿Alguien del equipo habla ruso?
messages.ru: Кто-нибудь из вашей команды говорит по-английски?

note: Asks for the policy, not to cancel anything. The policy is in the reference information. Trap: the word 'cancel' is not a handoff signal.

messages.en: What is your cancellation policy?
messages.pt: Qual é a política de cancelamento?
messages.es: ¿Cuál es su política de cancelación?
messages.ru: Какие у вас условия отмены бронирования?

note: Children over 8 are welcome in private rooms; a 10-year-old is covered.

messages.en: We'd like to come with our 10-year-old son. Is that okay?
messages.pt: Queremos ir com nosso filho de 10 anos. Tudo bem?
messages.es: Queremos ir con nuestro hijo de 10 años. ¿Es posible?
messages.ru: Мы хотим приехать с сыном, ему 10 лет. Это возможно?

note: No airport transfer; the team can send a taxi number after confirmation. A complete answer exists.

messages.en: Do you offer airport transfers?
messages.pt: Vocês oferecem transfer do aeroporto?
messages.es: ¿Ofrecen traslado desde el aeropuerto?
messages.ru: У вас есть трансфер из аэропорта?

note: Vegan meals are available if requested when booking.

messages.en: I'm vegan. Can you cater for that?
messages.pt: Sou vegano. Vocês conseguem atender a isso?
messages.es: Soy vegano. ¿Pueden adaptarse a eso?
messages.ru: Я веган. Вы можете это учесть?

note: The assistant cannot see the calendar. Without dates, it asks for them before a person checks availability.

messages.en: Do you have any rooms available?
messages.pt: Vocês têm quartos disponíveis?
messages.es: ¿Tienen habitaciones disponibles?
messages.ru: У вас есть свободные номера?

note: A booking request without dates, guests or room type: ask for the basics first.

messages.en: I'd like to book a room.
messages.pt: Quero fazer uma reserva.
messages.es: Quiero hacer una reserva.
messages.ru: Хочу забронировать номер.

note: A stay for a family without number of people, ages or dates: ask for the basics first.

messages.en: We are a family and would love to stay with you.
messages.pt: Somos uma família e adoraríamos ficar com vocês.
messages.es: Somos una familia y nos encantaría alojarnos con ustedes.
messages.ru: Мы семья и хотели бы у вас остановиться.

note: Refunds are handled by a person, even though the cancellation policy is documented.

messages.en: I cancelled my booking last week. When will I get my deposit back?
messages.pt: Cancelei minha reserva na semana passada. Quando vou receber o sinal de volta?
messages.es: Cancelé mi reserva la semana pasada. ¿Cuándo me devuelven el depósito?
messages.ru: Я отменил бронь на прошлой неделе. Когда мне вернут предоплату?

note: Complaints go to a person.

messages.en: The room was dirty and nobody helped us. I want to talk to someone.
messages.pt: O quarto estava sujo e ninguém nos ajudou. Quero falar com alguém.
messages.es: La habitación estaba sucia y nadie nos ayudó. Quiero hablar con alguien.
messages.ru: В номере было грязно, и нам никто не помог. Я хочу поговорить с кем-нибудь из администрации.

note: Availability with dates needs the booking calendar, which the assistant cannot see. Trap: it looks like a simple question.

messages.en: Do you have a private double room from March 12 to 15?
messages.pt: Vocês têm um quarto duplo privativo de 12 a 15 de março?
messages.es: ¿Tienen una habitación doble privada del 12 al 15 de marzo?
messages.ru: У вас есть двухместный номер с 12 по 15 марта?

note: Groups and private events are negotiated by a person.

messages.en: I'd like to organize a private retreat for 20 people in June. Can we talk about it?
messages.pt: Quero organizar um retiro privado para 20 pessoas em junho. Podemos conversar?
messages.es: Quiero organizar un retiro privado para 20 personas en junio. ¿Podemos hablar?
messages.ru: Я хочу организовать закрытый ретрит на 20 человек в июне. Можем это обсудить?

note: Discounts are exceptions decided by a person.

messages.en: Can you give us a discount if we stay for two weeks?
messages.pt: Vocês dão desconto se ficarmos duas semanas?
messages.es: ¿Hacen descuento si nos quedamos dos semanas?
messages.ru: Вы делаете скидку, если мы останемся на две недели?

note: Health and dietary-medical questions are not covered by the reference information and must not be answered by the assistant. Trap: it looks like a food question.

messages.en: I have coeliac disease. Is the food safe for me?
messages.pt: Tenho doença celíaca. A comida é segura para mim?
messages.es: Soy celíaco. ¿La comida es segura para mí?
messages.ru: У меня целиакия. Еда у вас для меня безопасна?

note: Payment problems go to a person.

messages.en: My card was charged twice for the deposit.
messages.pt: Meu cartão foi cobrado duas vezes pelo sinal.
messages.es: Me cobraron dos veces el depósito en mi tarjeta.
messages.ru: С моей карты дважды списали предоплату.

note: Press and partnership requests go to a person.

messages.en: I'm a journalist writing about retreat houses. Could I interview the owner?
messages.pt: Sou jornalista e escrevo sobre casas de retiro. Posso entrevistar o proprietário?
messages.es: Soy periodista y escribo sobre casas de retiro. ¿Podría entrevistar al propietario?
messages.ru: Я журналист и пишу о ретрит-центрах. Можно взять интервью у владельца?

note: Arriving at 1 a.m. is an exception (quiet hours are 22:00 to 07:00) and a person decides. Trap: it looks like logistics.

messages.en: Our flight lands late and we would arrive around 1 a.m. Is that possible?
messages.pt: Nosso voo pousa tarde e chegaríamos por volta de 1h da manhã. É possível?
messages.es: Nuestro vuelo aterriza tarde y llegaríamos hacia la una de la madrugada. ¿Es posible?
messages.ru: Наш рейс прилетает поздно, мы приедем около часа ночи. Это возможно?

note: A plausible question, but the reference information says nothing about a sauna. Anything not covered goes to a person.

messages.en: Do you have a sauna?
messages.pt: Vocês têm sauna?
messages.es: ¿Tienen sauna?
messages.ru: У вас есть сауна?

note: Someone's health is at risk right now.

messages.en: My friend fainted and is barely breathing. We are in room 3. Please help!
messages.pt: Minha amiga desmaiou e mal está respirando. Estamos no quarto 3. Ajudem, por favor!
messages.es: Mi amiga se desmayó y casi no respira. Estamos en la habitación 3. ¡Ayuda, por favor!
messages.ru: Моя подруга потеряла сознание и почти не дышит. Мы в комнате 3. Помогите, пожалуйста!

note: Guests are stranded at night with a nearly dead phone and need immediate contact.

messages.en: It's 11:30 p.m. and we are lost on the dirt road above Vale Verde. My phone is almost dead. Please call us!
messages.pt: São 23h30 e estamos perdidos na estrada de terra acima de Vale Verde. Meu celular está quase sem bateria. Por favor, liguem para nós!
messages.es: Son las 23:30 y estamos perdidos en el camino de tierra por encima de Vale Verde. Mi móvil casi no tiene batería. ¡Por favor, llámennos!
messages.ru: Уже 23:30, мы заблудились на грунтовой дороге выше Вале-Верде. Телефон почти разряжен. Пожалуйста, позвоните нам!

note: A gas smell is a safety risk right now.

messages.en: There is a strong smell of gas in the kitchen right now.
messages.pt: Tem um forte cheiro de gás na cozinha agora.
messages.es: Hay un fuerte olor a gas en la cocina ahora mismo.
messages.ru: Сейчас на кухне сильно пахнет газом.
